curation.notes: AFM single-molecule force spectroscopy of the polytopic membrane protein MelB (S. typhimurium, 42-aa polyGly C-terminal extension) in E. coli polar-lipid proteoliposomes, with and without co-reconstituted E. coli insertase YidC. MelB is fully or partially unfolded and extracted with the cantilever, then re-inserted into the membrane at a new location (folding times 0.5-5 s) to score folding/misfolding; FD-based AFM imaging (Nanoscope Multimode 8) localised protein-rich patches and SMFS used JPK NanoWizard II / II Ultra.

hardware.model_number: NanoWizard II / NanoWizard II Ultra (SMFS); Nanoscope Multimode 8 (FD-based AFM imaging)

evidence.snippet: Protein containing lipid patches were localized by AFM imaging (NanoWizard II Ultra/NanoWizard II, JPK Instruments) in SMFS buffer at ≈ 25 °C (Figure S1B,C).

acquisition_rate.note: PeakForce tapping oscillation frequency used for imaging, not SMFS

evidence.snippet: AFM topographs were recorded by applying imaging forces of 100 – 120 pN at 2 kHz oscillation frequency, with a vertical oscillation amplitude of 30 nm

afm.cantilever_model: OMCL-RC800PSA (Olympus) for SMFS; ScanAsyst-Fluid+ (Bruker) for imaging

spring_constant.note: nominal spring constant of the imaging cantilever; the SMFS cantilever value is not stated numerically

evidence.snippet: AFM topographs were recorded using cantilevers (ScanAsyst-Fluid+, Bruker Nano Inc.) having a nominal spring constant of 0.7 N m–1
the cantilever tip was pushed onto the membrane with a force of 700 pN for 0.5 s and retracted 250 nm with a velocity of 700 nm s–1

attachment_chemistry: non-specific tip attachment to polyGly-extended C terminus

evidence.snippet: retracted 250 nm with a velocity of 700 nm s–1

The plasmid pK95ΔAH/MelBST/polyGly/CHis9 encoding S. typhimurium MelB with a 42 aa polyGly linker and a 9xHis tag has previously been described.
The contour lengths of the elongated MelB (526 aa ≙ 190 nm) and YidC (559 aa ≙ 200 nm) polypeptides were calculated by assuming an amino acid backbone length of 0.36 nm aa–1.
pMS119 encoding for 10xHis-tagged YidC58 was used in this study. YidC was expressed in E. coli strain C43(DE3)

entities.name: E. coli polar lipid extract proteoliposome

evidence.snippet: E. coli polar lipid extract (Avanti Polar lipids) was prepared at 40 mg ml−1 in 1.2% (w:v) octyl-β-D-glucoside (OG, Anatrace).
